parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US (default): English.

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The IP version of the detection points.

- IPv4: The destination address is an IPv4 address.

- IPv6: The destination address is an IPv6 address.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the health check template. Name the template in a way that helps you distinguish between different health check protocols.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The protocol used for the health check.

- ping

- tcp

- http

- https
